title: Lunacaria Magic Academy
description:
Lunacaria is a academy dedicated to teaching magic. Every person is able to control a single element of magic. Lunacaria is the most prestigious magic academy and it has vast resources to train the best magic knights in the region. Those whom have a higher inate aptitude have the chance to commune with spirits and get their own familiar. These familiars can range from a floating sword to humanoid intelligent creatures capable of speaking. However Lunacaria separated students based on commoner and nobility backgrounds which causes a rivalry amongst students as nobility get access to better resources and amenities.

This is my first created scenario. Feedback, suggestions, and advice on how I can improve is appreciated. As I hope to update this to improve my writing and ideas to make better scenarios in the future!

As you flip the switch in the chamber your classification is officially designated as...

instructions:
You are an AI dungeon master that provides any kind of roleplaying game content.

Instructions: 
- Be specific, descriptive, and creative. 
- Avoid repetition and avoid summarization. 
- Generally use second person (like this: 'He looks at you.'). But use third person if that's what the story seems to follow. 
- Never decide or write for the user. If the input ends mid sentence, continue where it left off.
- > tokens mean a character action attempt. You should describe what happens when the player attempts that action. Generating '###' is forbidden.
- Write diverse and compelling characters each unique with their own motivations and personalities.
- Prioritize the user's input as context for writing for what happens next.

cardPool.title: Moderate
cardPool.value: Moderate Classification is the most common level given out to aspiring magic knights these people often have the least potential and as a result they get less than favorable treatment from the higher class students and also get the least amount of support from the school.

cardPool.title: Advanced
cardPool.value: Advanced classification is relatively uncommon and often have decent potential these are the students the Academy tries to spend a bit of effort and resources into as they have the potential to become good magic knights. They get good treatment as a result.

cardPool.title: Special
cardPool.value: The special Classification is to put it short a very rare class of aspirant magic knights these people have incredible potential and the academy goes through great lengths to raise these people up and make them the best they can be. The special class often becomes great magic knights and often become the vice captains of a magic knight order.

cardPool.title: Uber
cardPool.value: The Uber classification is the Elite amongst the Elite and it's a classification that rarely very few people get. The academy gets two or three Uber class students a year to enroll and that's if it's lucky. The Lunacaria academy faculty and council go through great lengths and expense to give these living prodigies the best resources and accommodations possible. These aspirants are the cream of the crop and these are the individuals that will become the captains of their very own magic knight order. If a commoner is given this classification even the nobility begrudgingly give them respect. Despite the classification most don't really boast about it and usually keep to themselves as it often makes them a target. By nefarious people and organizations.

cardPool.title: Fire Magic
cardPool.value: Fire magic specializes in wider range area of effect attacks the power is immense but is hard and difficult to control. Despite being one of the most common elements capable users are uncommon.

cardPool.title: Wind Magic
cardPool.value: Wind magic is great for those who favor physical combat. This element is very useful for mobility and increasing the power of their own attacks and the weakening of opponents attacks through control of the air pressure. This is also a fairly common element and masters of this element can even forge barriers of solid air to stop other's attacks in their tracks.

cardPool.title: Water Magic
cardPool.value: Water magic is the last of the common elements. Water magic users are the most versatile of the elements. Water magic has both cleansing and restorative properties. Water magic can heal wounds and help treat disease. Despite it's restorative properties. A capable user is able to use it to devastating effect summoning typhoons and waves to crush or immobile an enemy.

cardPool.title: Ice Magic
cardPool.value: Ice Magic is a uncommon magic type this element is commonly known for its ability to make solid objects or conjuring mini blizzards to debilitate enemies. You can create quite a lot with ice Magic including makeshift armor, weapons, and if the user should be powerful enough they can conjure fortifications such as a fort or tower. The ice Magic users can control how slippery and how effective the cold can be towards opponents and allies. Those with grand imaginations are amongst the best of magic casters

cardPool.title: Metal Magic
cardPool.value: Metal magic is a uncommon magic element and is put  into a unique position amongst the elements. These individuals who can use this often work as a smith for magic knight orders as these are the only people whom can make weapons and armor with special enchantments such as a never dulling blade or a armor that can self repair its self. With the bonding of another mage it's possible to make armor and weapons with an elemental affinity either boosting one's defense or casting ability with said element. The most talented individuals can easily forget equipment for a squadron of knights in mere minutes or create equipment that is worthy of song. Due to the nature of the magic it's offensive purposes are very limited but it's defensive and utility properties are second to none.

cardPool.title: Cosmic Magic
cardPool.value: This element is relatively rare and it's properties are very unique and sought after. Cosmic element users at the minimum are able to manipulate space around them. Allowing them to slightly alter the speed of time and able to blink short distances. Those who are highly skilled can teleport great distances if they can visualize the location and can summon meteors and even absorb energy from the heavens above to increase their speed, strength, and senses.

cardPool.title: Death Magic
cardPool.value: Death magic is a very rare type of magic. This magic at the minimum can summon bone constructs and wither away plant life. However those whom are truly attuned to this element can summon undead knights and other combatants to fight for them and kill most life instantly the exception being most magic casters. These individuals are either very basic at crafting defenses or on their own can turn the tide of a losing battle by summoning undead legions of soldiers, knights, and mages. The mages can be element casters or any type excluding Life. Those who have Death magic often have their eyes change color one being white and the other pitch black.

cardPool.title: Life Magic
cardPool.value: Life Magic is another very rare type of magic. It's the opposite of Death Magic in a way. It's the direct counter as they cancel each other. Life Magic users are the healers and some of the most prized people in a knight order. Due to their rarity the treatment of them is second to only the captain of a knight order. These individuals can heal and mend wounds, cure poisons and other ailments, and purge the undead, they however do not have much offensive utility outside of being able to grow trees and root like constructs. Those whom are the upper echelon can also revive deceased people with enough power however those that can do it are extremely rare.

cardPool.title: Lunar Magic
cardPool.value: Lunar magic users are quite unique in the fact that their magic is often stealth oriented. This is a rare magic type. Lunar magic users can conceal their presence and muffle their footsteps so they make great scouts or assassins during the day. However should it be night their full potential unleashes as they can cast lunar beams from their hands and draw power from the stars themselves to imbue themselves with more mana temporarily boosting their magic abilities.  The more talented casters can summon lunar runes in the ground to support allies by giving them minor ability increases to all attributes.

cardPool.title: Solar Magic
cardPool.value: Solar Magic is a rare magic element and the users command respect. These users during the day can use solar rays and solar flares to burn enemies and vaporize some defensive armaments. Any time during day or night They can cast spells that inspire comrades and fill them with hope. This makes these users excellent leaders and they can even cast miniature suns as temporary light sources should they need it. The higher level of casters or this type can cast wide range support spells to inspire and encourage entire battalions of soldiers and should enemies be caught in the radius can be given minor burns and it also reveals lunar casters

cardPool.title: Lunacaria Academy
cardPool.value: The top of the line and most prestigious magic academy. It has vast resources and accomodations for students to become the best magic knights they can possibly become. Although treatment does heavily differ depending on what classification and/or if a student is a noble or commoner.

cardPool.title: Noble
cardPool.value: Noble students get preferential treatment than commoner students and they often look down or outright discriminate against commoner students.

cardPool.title: Commoner
cardPool.value: Commoner students get treated not great or even terribly depending on their classification by the school faculty and noble students alike. They have it the hardest and often get little to no resources dedicated towards their growth.

cardPool.title: Earth Magic
cardPool.value: Earth Magic is a uncommon magic type that specializes in controlling the very dirt and stone beneath them. This can range from skewering their enemies with stone stalagtites or building A defensive barrier within seconds. Highly specialized users can manipulate the very nutrients and minerals in the ground to speed up the growth of plant life around them. This magic is generally more defensive in nature and their utility with plant life usually lands them at some form of position at a knight orders head quarters as both a corner stone defender and gardener.

cardPool.title: Familiars
cardPool.value: Familiars are echos of power of the elements themselves. Once a student reaches a certain threshold with their element they may be allowed to undergo a summon trial to even have a chance to obtain a familiar. How a familiar decides to answer one's call is entirely dependent on the magic potential, control, and mastery of one's skill. These familiars act as guardians and friends to those whom they've bonded and bound themselves too. Intelligent familiars often request something in return for their services.

cardPool.title: Royalty
cardPool.value: Royalty are typically defined not by title but purity of magical bloodline. Should a noble have a high enough magical bloodline purity they can elevate their house to a royal house. At Lunacaria they get access to the best accomodations and resources and even request special items or staff to help with their studies or endeavors. They also get the address benefit of choosing to have their own dorm or choosing the roommates they live with regardless of class.

cardPool.title: Herba Magic
cardPool.value: Herba magic casters are fairly rare. They for the most part accelerate A plant's growth and imbue plants with magical properties. Such as overloading an apple with magic turning it into a makeshift bomb or grenade.  These magic casters can also create new breeds of plants which normally wouldn't be possible. They're highly prized as plant breeders and as cultivators of rare medicinal plants and herbs. Herba magic users also have the ability to enhance the effects of alchemical potions if they're plant based.

cardPool.title: Dark Magic
cardPool.value: Dark Magic is a common magic type. Despite it being common it's proper applications have yet to be utilized by a majority of the populace simply because it's so hard to detect and even try to use in the first place. The casters and users of this magic are often quiet and reserved. Dark magic typically allows the caster to turn shadows into physical manifestations of their will. Let it be armor, weapons, and some rare cases sentient beings can be made from the shadows. Not only this when one acquires true mastery of this magic they can blink or "teleport" between shadows as long if it's within eyesight.

cardPool.title: Lightning Magic
cardPool.value: Lightning magic is a uncommon magic that is in high demand amongst merchants and the Army Corp. They can charge magical apparatuses and machinery. Their utility is unmatched and they also are a menace on the battlefield. They also can commune with a lightning cat spirit called Kasli. Kasli is an interesting spirit and often ignores most mortals. However, should someone with enough mana with an affinity for the lightning element it may come to serve them.

cardPool.title: Sound Magic
cardPool.value: Sound magic is a very rare magic type hardly seen. Its power is unique in the fact that it causes vibrations. It can be used to turn elements into different elements. Break down rocks into sand. Accelerate erosion. Burst ear drums, create music. Its applications are almost limitless. But typically, people choose to make beautiful music and become famous due to combining actual instruments and their magic and making new genres of music. It can even manipulate someone's voice to mimic another persons.
